title: pan brush
text: pan brush. This is a very handy tool if you use baking molds, use muffin pans - really any pan that has a edge.  I keep it in a jar near the sink.  Use carefully with non-stick pans, of course.  Has two head options.  I really like getting into those edges!

product_metadata.title: Nordic Ware Ultimate Bundt Cleaning Tool
features: 3-in-1 tool: includes angled brush, a flat scraper, and pointed pick for hard to reach spots on intricately detailed pans
Dishwasher use is not advised, as discoloration will occur due to the cleaning agents used in automatic dishwasher detergent.
Assorted colors- may receive Aqua or Grey
Great gift for any Bundt collector
description: This premium nonstick pans are truly easy to clean. But sometimes, sugars and oils get baked on and if they do, you'll appreciate this one-of-a-kind tool. Designed for baking enthusiasts with a rounded bristle, plastic flat edge scraper, and fine pick to get into every nook and cranny. A great gift for any Bundt collector.

details.Included Components: Flat scraper, Pointed pick, Angled brush
